provenance.selection_policy: Completed Jev results replace Jev on all 22 tasks. The raw-text head replaces the head on all 16 frozen eligible tasks, including regressions. Six changing-choice tasks retain their candidate-scoring adapter. The other five methods retain their measurements. Every method excludes the same three overlapping review bundles. No best-of-run selection.

jev.model_revision: Requested and recorded alias: typesafe-ai/jev. An immutable resolved revision was not recorded.
jev.condition: Persistent HTTP/1.1 client; all three review-label questions batched in one request per review.

hosted_run.latency_scope: Published median/p95 use successful-response time only. Failed attempts, retry backoff, benchmark pacing and QA pauses are excluded.
hosted_run.elapsed_scope: Active elapsed time includes all warm-ups, pacing, retries and checkpoint work, excluding documented QA pauses. It is benchmark wall time, not a per-customer request latency.
hosted_run.wait_estimate_scope: Timestamp-derived wait plus client overhead only for failed attempts attached to completed timed requests. It is not a complete count of every backoff, and excludes warm-up/interrupted-unit waits.

limitations: The raw-head and Jev processes overlapped for about 90 seconds on the laptop; measurements are not synchronized pairs or fully isolated runs.
No complete GPU measurement exists for the raw-text head. Superseded GPU values for its 16 tasks are deliberately absent.
Other methods and six candidate-scoring head tasks retain their earlier run measurements; host and measurement dates differ.
Hosted median/p95 include successful response execution only and exclude failed attempts, backoff, benchmark pacing and coordinated QA pauses.
These are small pilots, not general accuracy estimates. Three repeated passes do not triple the number of unique test examples.
